title: Understanding Critical Thinking in Generative Artificial Intelligence Use: Development, Validation, and Correlates of the Critical Thinking in AI Use Scale
reasoning: The paper develops and validates the 'Critical Thinking in AI Use Scale' (AICTS), which includes 'Reflection on responsible AI' as one of its three primary factors. This dimension explicitly evaluates a user's tendency to reflect on the moral, ethical, and societal consequences of AI outputs.
